canonical_claim.template: In 2025, {value} of the 1,563,370 FHA applications that lenders acted on were withdrawn by the applicant.

required_qualifiers.population: US FHA applications acted on (actions 1-5: originated, approved but not accepted, denied, withdrawn, closed for incompleteness; purchased loans and preapproval requests excluded; loan_type 2; reverse mortgages excluded)
required_qualifiers.denominator: applications acted on (actions 1-5), not decisioned applications (actions 1-3): the denied share of acted-on applications is lower than the published denial rate because withdrawn and incomplete files are in this denominator

does_not_establish: why any application ended where it did
that applicants withdraw because of lender conduct, or that files are closed because of applicant conduct
a comparison with the denial rate (22.1% of decisioned applications) without restating both denominators
rule: Free text is the OUTPUT of evidence, not its input. Certify before you write.

proposed_use.proposed_sentence: This lender will likely reject YOUR application
